esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; Sharp GP2Y0A02YK0F IR distance sensor (20-150 cm) needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.Vo → D32 (GPIO32) — an analog-capable pin. Added the gp2y0a02yk.py driver written from the datasheet.
Converts the Vo voltage on the slider to distance with the datasheet curve (1.24 V = 50 cm): passes
